patch_description: Add several complementary initialization orders before the existing relocation/swap improvement phase. The local search can only improve the basin produced by greedy placement, so diversified feasible starting layouts are valuable. In particular, pressure-per-post-placement-capacity prioritizes models that become expensive when paired with other models, while demand-and-size orderings distinguish equally demanding models based on their memory impact. This keeps the algorithm simple and only adds a small number of greedy passes.
